name: login-portal
description: Something answered with 200 and an HTML login page. The usual cause is a base URL pointing at a page inside Canvas rather than its root, or an SSO portal intercepting API requests.

response.text: <!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><title>Sign in</title></head><body><form method="post" action="/login"><input name="username"><input name="password" type="password"></form></body></html>
